ayahs.textUthmani: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۖ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ‌ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ١
ayahs.textIndopak: يُسَبِّحُ لِلّٰهِ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الۡاَرۡضِ​ۚ لَهُ الۡمُلۡكُ وَلَهُ الۡحَمۡدُ​ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ‏
ayahs.translation: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh.[1692] To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Yusabbihu lillaahi maa fis samaawaati Wa-maa fil ardi lahul mulku Wa-lahul hamd, Wa-Huwa 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: Everything in the heavens and the earth praises Allah. To Him belongs the kingdom, and to Him all praise is due, and He is Able to do all things.

ayahs.textUthmani: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُّؤْمِنٌ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ ٢
ayahs.textIndopak: هُوَ الَّذِىۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ فَمِنۡكُمۡ كَافِرٌ وَّمِنۡكُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنٌ​ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ‏
ayahs.translation: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
ayahs.transliteration: Huwal lathee khalaqakum faminkum kaafirunw Wa-min-kum mu'min; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona Baseer
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who created you. Some of you are unbelievers, and some of you are believers. And Allah perceives what you do.

ayahs.textUthmani: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ‌ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ٣
ayahs.textIndopak: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمۡ​ فَاَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡۚ​ وَاِلَيۡهِ الۡمَصِيۡرُ‏
ayahs.translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
ayahs.transliteration: Khalaqas samaawaati wal-arda bilhaqqi Wa-sawwarakum fa-ahsana suwarakum Wa-ilaihil maseer
ayahs.translationClear: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He designed you, and designed you well, and to Him is the final return.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ٤
ayahs.textIndopak: يَعۡلَمُ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُوۡنَ​ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ‏
ayahs.translation: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.transliteration: Ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-ya'lamu maa tusirroona Wa-maa tu'linoon; wallaahu 'Aleemum bithaatis sudoor
ayahs.translationClear: He knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and He knows what you conceal and what you reveal. And Allah knows what is within the hearts.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُوا۟ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ ٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَمۡ يَاۡتِكُمۡ نَبَـؤُا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَذَاقُوۡا وَبَالَ اَمۡرِهِمۡ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Alam ya'tikum naba'ul latheena kafaroo min qablu fathaaqoo wabaala amrihim Wa-lahum 'athaabun aleem
ayahs.translationClear: Has the news not reached you, of those who disbelieved before? They tasted the ill consequences of their conduct, and a painful torment awaits them.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟ ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرٌ يَهْدُونَنَا فَكَفَرُوا۟ وَتَوَلَّوا۟‌ۚ وَّٱسْتَغْنَى ٱللَّهُ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌ ٦
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰ لِكَ بِاَنَّهٗ كَانَتۡ تَّاۡتِيۡهِمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَقَالُوۡۤا اَبَشَرٌ يَّهۡدُوۡنَـنَا فَكَفَرُوۡا وَتَوَلَّوْا​ وَّاسۡتَغۡنَى اللّٰهُ​ ؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيۡدٌ‏
ayahs.translation: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allāh dispensed [with them]; and Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
ayahs.transliteration: Thaalika bi-annahoo kaanat ta'teehim Rusuluhum bilbaiyinaati faqaaloo a-basharuny yahdoonanaa fakafaroo Wa-tawallaw; wastaghnal laah; wallaahu ghaniyyun hameed
ayahs.translationClear: That is because their messengers came to them with clear explanations, but they said, “Are human beings going to guide us?” So they disbelieved and turned away. But Allah is in no need. Allah is Independent and Praiseworthy.

ayahs.textUthmani: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟ ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: زَعَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن لَّن يُبْعَثُوا۟‌ۚ قُلْ بَلَىٰ وَرَبِّى لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ‌ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ ٧
ayahs.textIndopak: زَعَمَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡۤا اَنۡ لَّنۡ يُّبۡـعَـثُـوۡا​ ؕ قُلۡ بَلٰى وَرَبِّىۡ لَـتُبۡـعَـثُـنَّ ثُمَّ لَـتُنَـبَّـؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلۡـتُمۡ​ؕ وَذٰ لِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ يَسِيۡرٌ‏
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allāh, is easy."
ayahs.transliteration: Za'amal latheena kafarooo al lany yub'asoo; qul balaa Wa-rabbee latub'asunna summa latunabba'unna bimaa 'amiltum; Wa-thaalika 'alal laahi yaseer
ayahs.translationClear: Those who disbelieve claim that they will not be resurrected. Say, “Yes indeed, by my Lord, you will be resurrected; then you will be informed of everything you did; and that is easy for Allah.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَـَٔامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلْنَا‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ ٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاٰمِنُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ وَرَسُوۡلِهٖ وَالنُّوۡرِ الَّذِىۡۤ اَنۡزَلۡنَا​ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ خَبِيۡرٌ‏
ayahs.translation: So believe in Allāh and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-aaminoo billaahi Wa-rasoolihee wannooril latheee anzalnaa; wallaahu bima ta'maloona khabeer
ayahs.translationClear: So believe in Allah and His Messenger, and the Light which We sent down. Allah is Aware of everything you do.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْجَمْعِ‌ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلتَّغَابُنِ‌ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ ٩
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوۡمَ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ لِيَوۡمِ الۡجَمۡعِ​ ذٰ لِكَ يَوۡمُ التَّغَابُنِ​ ؕ وَمَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنۡۢ بِاللّٰهِ وَيَعۡمَلۡ صَالِحًـا يُّكَفِّرۡ عَنۡهُ سَيِّاٰتِهٖ وَيُدۡخِلۡهُ جَنّٰتٍ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۤ اَبَدًا​ ؕ ذٰ لِكَ الۡفَوۡزُ الۡعَظِیْمُ‏
ayahs.translation: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation.[1693] And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yajma'ukum li-yawmil jam'i thaalika yawmut taghaabun; Wa-many yumim billaahi Wa-ya'mal saalihany yukaffir 'anhu sayyi-aatihee Wa-yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaaa abadaa; thaalikal fawzul 'azeem

footnotes.1693: "At-Taghābun" suggests having been outdone by others in the acquisition of something valued. That Day, the disbelievers will suffer the loss of Paradise to the believers.

ayahs.translationClear: The Day when He gathers you for the Day of Gathering—that is the Day of Mutual Exchange. Whoever believes in Allah and acts with integrity, He will remit his misdeeds, and will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow, to dwell therein forever. That is the supreme achievement.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا‌ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اُولٰٓٮِٕكَ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا​ ؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡمَصِيۡرُ‏
ayahs.translation: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
ayahs.transliteration: Wallatheena kafaroo Wa-kaththaboo bi-aayaaatinaaa ulaaa'ika ashaabun naari khaalideena feehaa Wa-bi'sal maseer
ayahs.translationClear: But as for those who disbelieve and denounce Our revelations—these are the inmates of the Fire, dwelling therein forever; and what a miserable fate!

ayahs.textUthmani: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ ١١
ayahs.textIndopak: مَاۤ اَصَابَ مِنۡ مُّصِيۡبَةٍ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِ​ؕ وَمَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنۡۢ بِاللّٰهِ يَهۡدِ قَلۡبَهٗ​ؕ وَاللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
ayahs.transliteration: Maaa asaaba mim musee-batin illaa bi-ithnil laah; Wa-many yu'mim billaahi yahdi qalbah; wallaahu bikulli shai'in Aleem
ayahs.translationClear: No disaster occurs except by Allah’s leave. Whoever believes in Allah, He guides his heart. Allah is Aware of everything.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ‌ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَىٰ رَسُولِنَا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ ١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوا الرَّسُوۡلَ​ۚ فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ فَاِنَّمَا عَلٰى رَسُوۡلِنَا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ‏
ayahs.translation: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-atee'ul laaha Wa-atee'ur Rasool; fa-in tawallaitum fa-innamaa 'alaa Rasoolinal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: So obey Allah, and obey the Messenger. But if you turn away—it is only incumbent on Our Messenger to deliver the clear message.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ‌ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ​ؕ وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Hoo; Wa-'alal laahi falyata-wakkalil mu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah, there is no god but He; and in Allah let the believers put their trust.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدِكُمْ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمْ فَٱحْذَرُوهُمْ‌ۚ وَإِن تَعْفُوا۟ وَتَصْفَحُوا۟ وَتَغْفِرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ ١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: ​يٰۤاَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡۤا اِنَّ مِنۡ اَزۡوَاجِكُمۡ وَاَوۡلَادِكُمۡ عَدُوًّا لَّكُمۡ فَاحۡذَرُوۡهُمۡ​ۚ وَاِنۡ تَعۡفُوۡا وَتَصۡفَحُوۡا وَتَغۡفِرُوۡا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Yaaa-ayyuhal latheena aamanooo inna min azwaaji-kum Wa-awlaadikum 'aduwwal lakum fahtharoohum; Wa-in ta'foo Wa-tasfahoo Wa-taghfiroo fa-innal laaha ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.translationClear: O you who believe! Among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon, and overlook, and forgive—Allah is Forgiver and Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَـٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةٌ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ ١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّمَاۤ اَمۡوَالُـكُمۡ وَاَوۡلَادُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٌ ​ؕ وَاللّٰهُ عِنۡدَهٗۤ اَجۡرٌ عَظِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaa amwaalukum Wa-awlaadukum fitnah; wallaahu 'indahooo ajrun 'azeem
ayahs.translationClear: Your possessions and your children are a test, but with Allah is a splendid reward.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرًا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْ‌ۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ ١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ مَا اسۡتَطَعۡتُمۡ وَاسۡمَعُوۡا وَاَطِيۡعُوۡا وَاَنۡفِقُوۡا خَيۡرًا لِّاَنۡفُسِكُمۡ​ؕ وَمَنۡ يُّوۡقَ شُحَّ نَفۡسِهٖ فَاُولٰٓٮِٕكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
ayahs.transliteration: Fattaqul laaha mas tata'tum wasma'oo Wa-atee'oo Wa-anfiqoo khairal li-anfusikum; Wa-many yooqa shuh-ha nafsihee fa-ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.translationClear: So be conscious of Allah as much as you can, and listen, and obey, and give for your own good. He who is protected from his stinginess—these are the prosperous.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ ١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنۡ تُقۡرِضُوا اللّٰهَ قَرۡضًا حَسَنًا يُّضٰعِفۡهُ لَـكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَـكُمۡ​ؕ وَاللّٰهُ شَكُوۡرٌ حَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.translation: If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative[1694] and Forbearing,[1695]
ayahs.transliteration: In tuqridul laaha qardan hasanany yudaaifhu lakum Wa-yaghfir lakum; wallaahu Shakoorun Haleem

footnotes.1694: Who gives much in return for little.

ayahs.translationClear: If you lend Allah a good loan, He will multiply it for you, and will forgive you. Allah is Appreciative and Forbearing.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ١٨
ayahs.translation: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.translationClear: The Knower of the Unseen and the Seen, the Almighty, the Wise.
